t: You are on Park Lane, a dual carriageway running from Hyde Park Corner in the south to Marble Arch in the north. Hyde Park lies to the west and Mayfair to the east. Despite the traffic, it has long been one of London's most sought-after addresses, with historic properties and hotels. Many notable people lived or died along it. Dame Shirley Porter, who led Westminster City Council, lived here, as did the businesswoman Amanda Staveley and the Victorian hostess Maria Kinnaird. The judge Henry Hawkins, Lord Brampton, died here. One historian called him probably the worst judge on the English bench in the nineteenth century.
